title: Image FX
description: An animated WebGL loader for image cards: a drifting pixel mosaic that dissolves into your image, then churns back into pixels to regenerate it.

props.name: images
props.description: The reveal pool: one URL, or several picked at random (never the same twice in a row). Same-origin or CORS-enabled, so regenerate can sample its colors.

props.name: preset
props.description: The effect: a flowing mosaic, a cloudier mosaic with flicker, or a fast diagonal sweep.

props.name: autoReveal
props.description: Loop on its own: shader, reveal, hold, hide, repeat.

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette; auto follows <html data-theme>, the dark/light class, color-scheme, then the system.

props.name: strength | speed | pixelScale
props.description: Effect opacity (above 1 boosts intensity), clock speed and cell size.

props.name: cardBg | colors
props.description: The card surface color, and per-slot palette overrides (up to 7).

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the shader and the scheduler.

props.name: ref
props.description: triggerReveal({ hold }), triggerHide(), triggerRegenerate({ durationMs, tintFromImage, autoReveal }), isImageActive(), element.

props.name: onCycle
props.description: Each phase change: idle, reveal, visible, hide.

props.name: excludeSrcs
props.description: Images to skip on the next pick, to keep several cards from showing the same one.

props.name: fragmentShader
props.description: Replaces the shared fragment shader (page-wide while set).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the static mosaic shown under reduced motion, without WebGL 2, while the context is lost and before the first frame.

props.name: allowSoftwareRenderer
props.description: Run the effect on a software WebGL renderer (no GPU) too. Off by default, because the shader then costs seconds per frame; the static picture shows instead.

a11y: The effect is decorative: both canvases and the fallback are aria-hidden, and the wrapped children keep their own semantics. Give the card an accessible name or aria-busy where the loader means something.

Reduced motion: nothing animates; a static mosaic in the preset's palette shows instead (also without WebGL 2, while the context is lost, before the first frame and on the server). The ref handle still shows and hides the image, without animation.
Drawing pauses off screen and in hidden tabs.
docs:
Installed `ImageFx` with its engine, presets and shaders in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/`. Wrap a card, or size the effect with `className`: `<ImageFx images={["/a.jpg", "/b.jpg"]} autoReveal className="h-72 w-80 rounded-2xl" />`. The corner radius follows the child (or the wrapper).

Drive it yourself with a ref: `ref.current?.triggerReveal({ hold: "manual" })`, `triggerHide()` and `triggerRegenerate({ durationMs: 3000 })`. One three.js renderer is shared by every card on the page (a single WebGL context, drawing at most 10 frames a second, 1.25x pixel ratio); each card's loop pauses off screen and in hidden tabs. Without WebGL 2 or under reduced motion a static mosaic shows instead.

Needs `three` (installed) and, for TypeScript, `@types/three`. `ImageGeneration` and its types are exported as aliases of upstream's names. Ported from Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev, the img-fx package (MIT, copyright 2026 Jakub Antalik); the license text is in each file.

Without a GPU (a software WebGL renderer) the effect shows its static picture; `allowSoftwareRenderer` overrides that.
